fields.h1: Build a Medical Waiver Form for Trips, Classes and Clinics
fields.hero_description: Build a medical waiver form that collects health answers, emergency contacts, and a signature before anyone takes part.
fields.features_heading: What Staff Have Before Anyone Takes Part
fields.features_subheading: Each signed waiver arrives with the health answers, the consent, and the dates a paper copy in a binder leaves out.
fields.feature_1:
Health questions asked one per screen

List the health questions your activity needs, and the form asks them one per screen on a phone. A yes opens a box for details and marks the waiver for a staff review.
fields.feature_2:
Emergency treatment consent, initialed

Write the clause that lets staff seek emergency care for a participant. The signer initials it before signing, and the initials and the time are saved with the waiver.
fields.feature_3:
Alerts that leave health answers out

An email or in-app alert says that a waiver is in and links to the record. The health answers stay in the database you own, and none of them is copied into the message.
fields.feature_4:
Insurance cards read into fields

Participants photograph the front of their insurance card. The app reads the insurer and member number into fields, and any value it cannot read goes back to them to type.
fields.feature_5:
One list of who has signed

Every participant sits on one list with a signed date, a review flag, and an expiry date. Filter by trip or class, and send an email reminder to each person still unsigned.
fields.feature_6:
Your code, in your GitHub repository

On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository, host the waiver app on your own servers, and keep it next to the registration system you already rely on.
fields.why_title: Why Build a Medical Waiver Form on Emergent?
fields.why_description: A printed waiver records a signature. This app also holds the activity after a yes answer and leaves health details out of alerts.

fields.usecase_heading: Who Signs, and What Staff See Next
fields.tab_content_1:
Who is unsigned 10 days before the flight

Grace Hollow Church is sending 22 travelers on a mission trip, each with their own waiver link. Travelers add emergency contacts, photograph their insurance card, and initial consent to treatment abroad. The trip leader's list, 10 days before the flight, shows 19 of 22 signed. The other 3 get an email reminder that morning.
fields.tab_content_2:
Into the pool only after a doctor clears a yes

Students at Pelican Reef Divers answer the school's health questions before their first pool session. A yes holds the booking until a physician's clearance letter is uploaded. The instructor's email says a waiver needs review and links to the record, with none of the answers. Of 12 students in Saturday's class, 2 are on hold.
fields.tab_content_3:
Four risk paragraphs, initialed one by one

Ospry Hydration wrote 4 paragraphs on the risks of an IV drip, and each client initials all 4 before signing. The waiver link goes out with the booking confirmation. On Tuesday's schedule at the front desk, every signed client has a check, and the 9:00 a.m. client who has not signed is flagged before arriving.
fields.tab_content_4:
Renewal emails 14 days before each waiver turns one

Sorrel Gate Stables asks riders to sign again every 12 months. When a waiver is 14 days from turning one year old, the rider gets an email with a link to the current form. This month, 9 riders are due. A rider whose waiver lapses is marked on the lesson list until a new signature is in.

plan.angle: The live top 10 is printable PDFs on Pinterest, a church permission slip, one clinic vendor's template and a few fill-and-sign editors, and every result stops at a document. This page shows the three jobs a medical waiver does (health disclosure, emergency treatment authorization, risk acknowledgement), then what a PDF cannot do: hold an activity until the waiver is signed or a doctor has cleared a yes answer, keep health answers out of email alerts, and ask for a new signature when a waiver turns one year old.
